text: Delivered on local main (unpushed) through b09e835; plan docs/plans/2026-10-02-interaction-06-linked-views.md. Commits 665e595 (shared projection/emphasis/legend links/axes), acb73f0 (widget linking + WidgetLink + fixture + browser check), e57b651 and b09e835 (fixes for 11 findings of an independent review). Criteria: (1) two differently ordered scatters link selection and hover by entity key (ring containment proves key, not row index); category legend hover/click links via LegendLink, validated at mount; (2) impostor key spaces with identical namespace text never join (entity, link and link-group level); missing keys reported via onMissing; data replacement reconciles and later projections report missing; (3) Projected projection + display-only emphasis: no echo events across a 4-widget group and a 3-controller cycle; one live link per widget; (4) LinkedAxes.compatible / converted (identity transform, interior check) - checks only, no shared viewport host yet; (5) histogram bins selected as bins stay local and never clear linked selections. Evidence: LinkedViewsSuite 7/7 JVM+JS; linked browser check 11/11 and widget check 15/15 on Chromium 151.0.7922.34; compat exit 0; testAll 16 targets green; docs compile 0 errors (docs gate currently reports stale gallery plates from another agent's uncommitted gallery.md redesign). Not established: shared data-window viewport (Interaction 05), exact aggregate membership (09), multi-link relays (refused by design). Closing.
